name: Customer & Employee AI
short: Self-service, service teams and internal operations.
problem: Repeated inquiries and fragmented policy information consume service time.
role: Own portfolio strategy, discovery and delivery across business and AI teams.
vision: Resolve routine needs digitally; give people the context for complex cases.
kpis: Target: 10% lower handling time · Cost per resolution · Handoffs
outcome: Portfolio ownership and assistant iteration. The 10% reduction is a future target.
details: A customer or employee asks a service question.
The journey selects relevant policy and knowledge sources with permissions.
An assistant prepares a source-grounded answer or guidance.
A person handles exceptions with context rather than repeating the search.

name: Digital Underwriting
short: Medical information, green paths and reinsurance.
problem: Manual medical-file review and fragmented checks delay underwriting.
role: Lead end-to-end product definition, stakeholder alignment and integration scope.
vision: Green paths for eligible cases; expert review for exceptions.
kpis: Target: ~40% less manual effort · Green-path rate · Quality
outcome: Product definition and evaluation. The 40% reduction is a planned target.
details: Collect questionnaires and medical documents for the application.
Build a source-linked profile and identify missing evidence.
Evaluate green-path eligibility and reinsurance integration requirements.
Route exceptions to an underwriter; keep professional accountability.

name: Claims Decision Support
short: Medical and legal evidence in one review flow.
problem: Claims handlers rebuild case context across medical and legal documents.
role: Lead discovery and product definition; build the interactive prototype.
vision: Less preparation effort and more time for professional assessment.
kpis: Target: 20% less preparation & review effort · Source completeness
outcome: Interactive prototype and roadmap. The 20% reduction is a future target.
details: Bring medical records, judgments and expert opinions into the case.
Prepare a claimant profile and source-linked summary.
Connect findings and identify evidence requiring investigation.
A claims handler assesses the case with source context and retains the decision.
